notes.title: LUCID Demo : 1.0.1 Patch
notes.content:
[previewyoutube="6pffPfsD5Xs;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]THANK YOU ALL SO MUCH[/b] [/p][p]I'm so grateful to everyone for playing the [b]LUCID Demo[/b]. [/p][p]I cant believe how well the reception has been.[/p][p][/p][p]I have recently pushed a [b]NEW PATCH[/b] that addresses the following:[/p][p][/p][p]- [b]Totem Heads[/b] : larger Hit Box / No longer have timer that turns them off[/p][p]- [b]BOSS - Sentinel Bludgeon[/b] : lower health / lowered amount of pulses needed to Guard Break / Sentries in fight have lower hp[/p][p]- speed up text reveal speed[/p][p]- Reduced "Got Item" sequences by 1 second[/p][p]- Lanterns that need to be touched after Touching a Crystal Basin : increase visibility / no longer have timer to turn Off[/p][p]- Temple Circuit 1 - adjusted design difficulty (more save landings)[/p][p]- Some more shards in overworld to help navigate player[/p][p]- Increased Pause Menu Highlight Outline Selection visibility [/p][p][/p][p][b][u]BUGS[/u][/b][/p][p][i]- Fixed rare instance when moving between rooms player would appear out of level bounds[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed certain objects not respawning[/i][/p][p][i]- Fixed certain objects not triggering if room is left while they were being activated[/i][/p][p]
Again, thank you all for playing![/p][p]Please tell your friends to give the LUCID Demo a try, and to Add LUCID to their WISHLIST!

Cheers!

Eric[/p][p]
[/p]

tags.balance_change: - Totem Heads : larger Hit Box / No longer have timer that turns them off
- BOSS - Sentinel Bludgeon : lower health / lowered amount of pulses needed to Guard Break / Sentries in fight have lower hp
- Lanterns that need to be touched after Touching a Crystal Basin : increase visibility / no longer have timer to turn Off
- Temple Circuit 1 - adjusted design difficulty (more save landings)
- Some more shards in overworld to help navigate player
- Increased Pause Menu Highlight Outline Selection visibility

tags.bug: - Fixed rare instance when moving between rooms player would appear out of level bounds
- Fixed certain objects not triggering if room is left while they were being activated
